name: Tempest's Coming Storm Championship
aka: the soon to be renamed PWA Championship
epitaph: Held by exactly one man in the surviving record, defended once on the academy's own February 2003 card, and renamed in a June 2003 tournament announcement the surviving record does not carry a result for.
note: The academy's own record disagrees with itself about whether it had a belt at all: its February 2003 rules page says "no titles," while the 9 Feb 2003 card stages a singles match for this title with a champion already billed, and a June 2003 news post runs a tournament for "the soon to be renamed PWA Championship." Both readings stand (#sources-disagree); no result for the June tournament survives.
